workspaces.description: ChamSys MagicQ professional lighting console software. Full 64-universe DMX control, visualiser, and fixture library. Shows persist across sessions.
workspaces.notes: Shows are stored persistently under ~/MagicQ/shows via a volume mount. Heads and personalities are pre-expanded in the image. MagicQ PC edition — 64 universes fully enabled.

workspaces.description: Ubuntu Jammy desktop with Claude Code CLI - Anthropic AI coding assistant accessible from a browser-streamed terminal.
NousResearch Hermes Agent with Kori-x real-time dashboard. Built-in s6-overlay supervision runs the gateway, built-in dashboard, and Kori-x monitoring UI together in one container.
workspaces.notes: Set Proxy Port to 5173 for the Kori-x monitoring dashboard, or 9119 for the built-in config/session dashboard, or 8642 for raw API access. Mount a persistent volume at /opt/data to preserve config, API keys, sessions, skills, and memories across workspace restarts. Ports: 8642 (OpenAI-compatible API + health), 9119 (built-in dashboard), 5173 (Kori-x UI), 3001 (Kori-x WebSocket), 3002 (Kori-x wiki API).

workspaces.description: Open-source home automation platform. Control smart home devices, create automations, and monitor your home from a unified web interface on port 8123.
LiteLLM Proxy - a unified API gateway for 100+ LLMs including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini and local models. Exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on port 4000.

Professional lighting fixture management via RDM (ANSI E1.20) over ArtNet/sACN. Integrates with grandMA2 (Telnet) and grandMA3 (OSC), imports MVR files for fixture layout, runs ArtPoll node discovery, and includes a DHCP server for lighting network setup.
workspaces.notes:
IMPORTANT: This workspace requires --network=host (already set) for ArtNet UDP broadcast and sACN multicast to reach the lighting rig.

Port 80: RDM Fixture Manager web UI
/ola/ proxies the OLA daemon web interface on port 9090

A host volume /opt/rdm-data is mounted at /app/data for persistent show files.

The host must be on the same subnet as your DMX/ArtNet nodes (Luminex, ELC, etc.).
